verdict.rationale: Wise states its card lets you pay and withdraw cash worldwide without hidden fees or markups. Its docs also cover issuing debit cards worldwide and controlling ATM and other spending permissions, which together cover the core of the story. The evidence is mostly high-level marketing copy and is not specific to Business cards. Missing for 10: a published fee schedule (ATM withdrawal limits, conversion fees), explicit confirmation that these terms apply to Wise Business company cards, and independent or hands-on corroboration of no hidden foreign fees.

support.subject: As a founder, I can spend and withdraw cash abroad on a company card without hidden foreign fees

citations.quote: Pay and withdraw cash worldwide without any hidden fees or markups.
Control spending permissions (e-commerce, ATM, contactless, magnetic stripe, etc.)
